scenario.title: Rising EM counts in Fill Room 3
scenario.description: Environmental monitoring in Fill Room 3 reaches the action level after three days of rising counts. The worn gasket from lot G-77 on Filler 3 is the source. The missing Oct 9 cleaning record is a red herring.

redHerrings.description: Oct 9 cleaning record for Fill Room 3 is missing.

hiddenTruth.rootCause: Worn gasket from lot G-77 on Filler 3 is shedding contamination into Fill Room 3.
